settings.headline:
An entrance
with character.
settings.intro: Custom gates, railings, staircases and balconies. Designed, manufactured and installed around your property.
settings.name: DJB Engineering
settings.address: 35 Lisbarnet Road, Lisbane, Comber, Newtownards, BT23 6AW

services.title: Bespoke Gates
services.body: Gates designed around the opening, setting and style of your property. DJB produces manual and automatic gates, with swinging and sliding configurations for residential and commercial applications. Bring your own specification or develop a design with the team.

services.title: Railings
services.short: Define the edge with considered steelwork.
services.body: Straight or curved railings made to suit your property. DJB designs, manufactures and fits styles ranging from simple contemporary lines to classical detailing, for homes and commercial premises.

services.title: Staircases
services.short: Steel stairs shaped around the space.
services.body: DJB manufactures and installs bespoke steel stairs for residential and commercial settings. The team can develop a design around your requirements or work from your own specification.

services.title: Balconies
services.body: Bespoke balconies designed and fabricated to suit the building, whether the brief calls for a compact structure or a larger installation. Discuss the layout and preferred style with the team.

services.title: Dog Runs
services.body: Custom dog runs manufactured in a range of sizes and duty levels. DJB can design an enclosure around your requirements or fabricate to an existing specification.

services.title: Bespoke Fabrication
services.short: Bring your steelwork brief to life.
services.body: DJB manufactures custom steel structures for individual project requirements. Finishes can include galvanising and powder coating. Share drawings or discuss a design with the team.
